primaryChecks.text: Then Solomon went to Ezion Geber and to Eloth, on the seashore in the land of Edom.
primaryChecks.previousContext: Now all the work of Solomon was accomplished from the day of the foundation of the LORD’s house until it was finished. So the LORD’s house was completed.
primaryChecks.nextContext: Huram sent him ships and servants who had knowledge of the sea by the hands of his servants; and they came with the servants of Solomon to Ophir, and brought from there four hundred fifty talents of gold, and brought them to King Solomon.
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 本文に地名が明記され、当該文脈でこの町・地形として用いられる。

primaryChecks.text: He built Eloth and restored it to Judah. After that the king slept with his fathers.
primaryChecks.previousContext: All the people of Judah took Uzziah, who was sixteen years old, and made him king in the place of his father Amaziah.
primaryChecks.nextContext: Uzziah was sixteen years old when he began to reign; and he reigned fifty-two years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jechiliah, of Jerusalem.
primaryChecks.decisionJa: ウジヤが再建しユダに戻した町として同じ名が現れる。
